senses.definition: A protein expressed in the larva of the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster, required for the proper development of the larval body.
A blood group system involving the presence of either the H or the h antigen on the surface of a person's red blood cells.
A sigh; indicates distress, discomfort, boredom or confusion.
Triple H, former American professional wrestler.
A rare autosomal-recessive urea cycle disorder affecting the enzyme ornithine translocase, which causes ammonia to accumulate in the blood.
